column1: # Game profile of Super Mario Party Jamboree (Switch, update 2.3.0).
# Earlier Mac bring-up reached a board with correct spaces; validation on current main is pending.
# Bezel engine, SDK 17, NVN. No game-specific host branches or rewriter cuts.
# Three ordinary modules and 139 collected runtime NROs; subsdk0 supplies the movie decoder.
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so the SDK uses virtual address memory.
# For the main build above, nninitStartup at +0x982840 requests 0xe00000000 (56 GiB)
# for StandardAllocator. The alias region covers this virtual reservation; it does not commit 64 GiB of RAM.
# BNSH in version-6 Bezel archives and in main. Source groups are labels, not rendering overrides.
